questions.question: When you picture your ideal daily tasks in tech, what do you prefer doing?

options.label: A
options.text: Writing code, building applications, designing interfaces, or creating interactive game graphics.

options.label: B
options.text: Investigating security threats, auditing vulnerabilities, and defending network environments.

options.label: C
options.text: Training smart data models, analyzing big data patterns, and building automated tools.

options.label: D
options.text: Configuring routers, setting up cloud hardware, and keeping system backbones running smoothly.

options.label: E
options.text: Leading agile sprint teams, planning projects, or designing user-centric web/app interfaces.

questions.question: When you graduate, what kind of project or real-world impact would you love to focus on?

options.label: A
options.text: Building slick mobile apps people use daily, or crafting fun, interactive video games and digital experiences.

options.label: B
options.text: Protecting companies from hackers, investigating cyber attacks, or keeping digital and industrial control systems safe.
matched_programs: Bachelor of Information Sciences – Cyber Security

options.label: C
options.text: Using smart data and AI to solve complex puzzles, automate predictions, or create intelligent solutions.
matched_programs: Artificial Intelligence Development and Applications (Graduate Certificate)

options.label: D
options.text: Building and maintaining the backbone technology—ensuring enterprise routers, cloud servers, and networks stay online.
matched_programs: Computer Systems Technician – Information Technology Infrastructure Services

options.label: E
options.text: Managing tech teams and project workflows from start to finish, or creating engaging user interface designs without heavy back-end coding.

options.label: F
options.text: Designing large-scale enterprise software architectures and mastering core computing theory.
matched_programs: Computer Systems Technology – Software Development and Network Engineering (Advanced Diploma)
